source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    perimeter = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                 if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] != 0]
    frame = max(set(perimeter), key=perimeter.count)
    inner_cells = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] != frame]
    if not inner_cells:
        return out
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in inner_cells), max(r for r, c in inner_cells)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in inner_cells), max(c for r, c in inner_cells)
    color = grid[inner_cells[0][0]][inner_cells[0][1]]
    thickness = min(ir0 - r0, r1 - ir1, ic0 - c0, c1 - ic1)
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - thickness), min(len(grid), r1 + thickness + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - thickness), min(len(grid[0]), c1 + thickness + 1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]

        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    border = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
              if (r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1)) and grid[r][c] != 0]

    core = [(r, c) for r, c in cells if grid[r][c] != outer_color]

    core_h = max(r for r, c in core) - min(r for r, c in core) + 1
    core_w = max(c for r, c in core) - min(c for r, c in core) + 1
    pad = min(core_h, core_w, r0, len(grid) - 1 - r1, c0, len(grid[0]) - 1 - c1)
    for r in range(r0 - pad, r1 + pad + 1):
        for c in range(c0 - pad, c1 + pad + 1):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = core_color
    return out
